vectors.scenario: registry, custodian and ledger representation all match canonical right
authoritative registry points to different asset/right
ledger representation legal instrument hash differs
registry/custody/representation status is suspended, revoked or unknown
two record classes reuse the same evidence hash
record claims external effects or finality
WORKS claims alignment while independent verifier sees mismatch

required_invariants: token or ledger representation is never legal truth by itself
authoritative registry, custody and representation evidence are distinct
assetId and rightId match across all records
all source records must be ACTIVE
source evidence hashes cannot be reused
alignment does not establish legal title or legal finality
non_claims: registry evidence is legally conclusive in every jurisdiction
